name: Editor switches deck theme instantly without losing slide content
description: Changing the Theme select in the editor re-renders the slide canvas with the new theme while all slide text stays intact.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app root URL /, stay on the 'Studio — structured' tab, type the brief 'Product launch plan for a mobile fitness app' into the 'A · Brief' textarea and click 'Forge the outline'.
Wait for the 'Outline proposal' view, then click 'Approve & write N slides' and wait until the editor/board view opens with a rendered slide (allow up to 120 seconds).
Verify the editor shows a slide canvas, a slide navigation or board area, a 'Theme' selector and an Export menu button.
Read the currently selected value of the Theme selector, then open the Theme selector and choose a DIFFERENT theme from the list.
Verify the slide canvas re-renders with visibly different colors or typography, and the previously visible slide title text is still present on the canvas (content preserved).
Navigate to the next slide using the slide navigation (next arrow or clicking a slide in the board).
Verify the canvas now shows the next slide and the new theme is still applied (theme applies deck-wide).
Open the Theme selector again and switch back to the original theme.
Verify the canvas re-renders with the original theme styling and content is still intact.
